newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea says soldiers wounded in clash.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea says soldiers wounded in clash.

text.p: North Korea on Wednesday accused South Korea of launching a "grave military provocation act" against the communist state in which it said several North Korean soldiers were wounded.

In a special Radio Pyongyang broadcast at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Wednesday, North Korea said South Korean military forces launched a "grave military provocation act" near the border dividing the two Koreas. The broadcast, monitored by Tokyo-based Radiopress news agency, said "several" North Korea soldiers were injured.
Earlier in Seoul, a South Korean defence ministry official said North and South Korean soldiers exchanged fire at the border on Wednesday.

"The shooting broke out after a group of North Korean soldiers crossed the Military Demarcation Line in the western sector of the frontier at around 10.50 a.m. (0150 GMT). They returned to the north at around noon," the official said.
The Military Demarcation Line runs midway through the four-km (2.5-mile) wide Demilitarized Zone that bisects the peninsula.
